instruction: Townhouse Pair Drawing Set and Room Schedule This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.ifc, result.pdf, and result.txt. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited room schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 12 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcWall entity, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 2 IfcStair entities. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: A-LIVING, A-DINING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-LIVING, B-DINING, B-KITCHEN, B-BATH, B-BED-1, B-BED-2. 7. A-LIVING, A-DINING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, B-LIVING, B-DINING, B-KITCHEN, B-BATH are assigned to one storey; and A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-BED-1, B-BED-2 are assigned to a second storey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [12.0, 6.5, 6.6]. 9. Result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, Area. 10. Result.txt has exactly 12 data rows in this order: A01 A-LIVING 16.0, A02 A-DINING 6.0, A03 A-KITCHEN 7.5, A04 A-BATH 5.0, A05 A-BED-1 9.0, A06 A-BED-2 6.0, B01 B-LIVING 16.0, B02 B-DINING 6.0, B03 B-KITCHEN 7.5, B04 B-BATH 5.0, B05 B-BED-1 9.0, B06 B-BED-2 6.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10. 11. Result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, SECTION, TOWNHOUSE PAIR, UNIT A, UNIT B, A-LIVING, B-LIVING. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
